verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout badly. The headline is blown up into two huge lines that crowd the right column, and the CTA is bloated. The tagline is pulled away from the headline and stranded top-right above the button. The flavour chips are reversed and jammed under the CTA, nearly touching the headline's 'here', and the SOLSTICE wordmark is shrunk. B keeps the original hierarchy, grid and chip order nearly intact. Its only issues are minor: the decorative circles are enlarged, so the yellow one sits behind the headline and chips and the pink one frames the CTA more heavily than in the original, and the chip labels are still tiny.
